So the physical asset and its gas-supply function are real. It taps the Baiji-Mosul gas trunk (roster P1842 'Baiji-Al Mushraq Gas Pipeline', ?->Mosul, 18-in) but is a distinct 22 km spur to the power station — the wiki slug 'Baiji-Mousal-Al_Qayyarah' just records that tie-in.
